mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates monetary easing, which reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 6.5%, it signals labor market distress and reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 6.5%), or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals worsening supply conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Positive quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates economic expansion, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 growth is positive, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is at or below 0.5%, it signals an extreme monetary easing policy, which boosts equity valuations and produces positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate a deteriorating labor market, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS decline and UNRATE rise fails to predict negative returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a recession (GDPC1 growth negative), a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals further demand weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 growth is negative and HOUST declines, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 2-year windows.
